subject: Using a multivariate prior with R-INLA

messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Using a multivariate prior with R-INLA
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to fit a model that uses a multivariate prior but I am not sure that I can do it with R-INLA. Say that the model is a standard linear regression with two covariates and that I want to put a bivariate prior on the coefficients. The prior I want to use is not implemented in R-INLA. What would it be the best way to include such a prior?

I have noticed the "expression:" and "table:" priors but I do not this these are suitable to define a multivariate prior.

I think that I could use the same approach as in [1] where we fixed the values of the model parameters and then fit some conditional models with a prior of our choice and combine then using Bayesian Model Averaging, but I am wondering whether there is a simpler approach.

Many thanks,

Virgilio

[1]"Approximate Bayesian inference for spatial econometrics models”. Spatial Statistics, Volume 9, 2014, pp. 146–165 (with Virgilio Gómez-Rubio and Håvard Rue)
